sources.label: Wikipedia, "Lambda Aquarii"
sources.quote: Lambda Aquarii, Latinized from λ Aquarii and formally named Shatabhisha, is a variable star in the equatorial constellation of Aquarius.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 1,631 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,702 K, so 98.304 solar radii.

sources.label: McDonald et al. (2017), Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society 471 770-791

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Lambda Aquarii"
sources.quote: The apparent visual magnitude of this star ranges from 3.57 down to 3.80, which is bright enough to be visible with the naked eye.
